title: Pan-Seared Goat Chop with Spicy Rice
description: A flavorful and spicy dish that pairs pan-seared goat chops with a side of aromatic rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the goat chops with salt, pepper, and a pinch of freshly ground peppercorns.
Sear the goat chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the chops to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add 1 cup of uncooked Dutch rice and stir to coat with oil.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in 1/4 cup of fried onions (if using).
Serve the pan-seared goat chops with the spicy rice on the side.
